Done. Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/SerializationUtilsAgentTest.java`.

**Style match:** JUnit 4 (`org.junit.Test` / `@Before`, `import static org.junit.Assert.*`, try/`fail`/catch for exception assertions), same license header and `@version $Id$` Javadoc as siblings like `ObjectUtilsTest` / `RangeTest`.

**Coverage (26 tests, public API only):**

| Method | Happy path | Boundary / error |
|---|---|---|
| `SerializationUtils()` | constructs, reflection checks 1 public ctor / non-final class | — |
| `serialize(Serializable)` | round-trips a `HashMap` (content asserted); byte-for-byte equal to a raw `ObjectOutputStream` | `null` obj → valid stream decoding to `null`; non-`Serializable` payload → `SerializationException` w/ `IOException` cause |
| `serialize(Serializable, OutputStream)` | bytes equal raw `ObjectOutputStream`; verifies stream is closed | `null` stream → `IllegalArgumentException` ("The OutputStream must not be null"); `null` obj; unserializable → `SerializationException` |
| `deserialize(byte[])` | restores equal-but-not-same map; preserves runtime type (`String`) | `null` → IAE ("The byte[] must not be null"); corrupt bytes → `SerializationException`/`IOException`; empty array → same |
| `deserialize(InputStream)` | restores equal map; `null`-encoded → `null` | `null` → IAE ("The InputStream must not be null"); corrupt stream → `SerializationException` |
| `clone(Serializable)` | equal-but-not-same map with equal entries; deep independence (nested `Date` is a distinct instance, mutating clone leaves original intact); `Integer` subtype round-trips | `null` → `null`; unserializable → `SerializationException`; `testPrimitiveTypeClassSerialization` clones `byte.class`…`void.class` (the Lang-13 regression) |

Verified:
- `defects4j compile` → OK (compile + compile.tests)
- `java -cp "$(defects4j export -p cp.test)" org.junit.runner.JUnitCore org.apache.commons.lang3.SerializationUtilsAgentTest` → `OK (26 tests)`
